content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Deoghar Data Entry Operator Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for the AIIMS Deoghar recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for the AIIMS Deoghar recruitment is Data Entry Operator. This is a contractual position announced through a walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Data Entry Operator post at AIIMS Deoghar. This is a single opening announced in the latest recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted through a walk-in interview. The walk-in interview date is 18 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Data Entry Operator role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Data Entry Operator position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 29,200/- per month.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Data Entry Operator post?
faq.answer: Candidates need a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, OR Intermediate/12th pass in science with DOEACC 'A' level and 2 years of EDP experience, OR Intermediate/12th pass in science. A typing speed of 8000 key depressions per hour and MS Office knowledge are also required.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Data Entry Operator position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Data Entry Operator position is 30 years. Age relaxation will be provided for SC/ST/OBC candidates as per government norms.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the Data Entry Operator job at AIIMS Deoghar?
faq.answer: The application process is through a walk-in interview. Candidates need to report to the specified venue on the walk-in date with all required documents.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Data Entry Operator recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Walk-in Interview, followed by shortlisting based on typing speed if there are more than 30 applicants, and finally Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this Data Entry Operator recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the walk-in interview for AIIMS Deoghar Data Entry Operator recruitment scheduled?
faq.answer: The official notification should be checked for the exact venue address. However, the recruitment is for AIIMS Deoghar, located in Deoghar, Jharkhand, with pincode 814152.
